name: Decimate and Bake Atlas
explanation_long: Decimates to a lower face count, creates a UV atlas and bakes material properties such as color, normals, and occlusion into textures. This improves performance for real-time assets in games or XR.

exposed_options.name: Texture Baking Resolution
exposed_options.description: Steers the Resolution of the baked textures, default is 4096x4096 pixels.

exposed_options.name: Bake Occlusion Map
exposed_options.description: Bakes ambient occlusion map for the whole model. If UVs are preserved, the occlusion is baked into the 2nd UV set.

exposed_options.name: Texture Resolution Auto Scaling
exposed_options.description: If set, the texture resolution only applies to the largest atlas in terms of occupied 3D surface, smaller atlases will receive a smaller power of 2 resolutions depending on their mesh size in 3D.

exposed_options.name: Face Target
exposed_options.description: The target amount of faces (triangles), default is 200,000 triangles.

exposed_options.name: Deviation Percentage
exposed_options.description: Target percentage of deviation relative to the original mesh. Works in conjunction with face target as a cap, depending on that the final face count can be lower or equal to the face count.

exposed_options.name: Size on Screen Target
exposed_options.description: Calculates optimal mesh and texture resolution for a given display size on screen in pixel. This method is optional and can work standalone or in conjunction with other targets. Default is 0 (=off).

exposed_options.name: Preserve Tiling
exposed_options.description: Preserves repeating texture coordinates (UVs) and associated texture maps. UVs are considered tiling if they extend beyond 0-1 UV space.

exposed_options.name: Atlas Mode
exposed_options.description: Mode used to assign atlases. By default atlases are separated by opacity (separateAlpha), separateMaterials creates an atlas per material for all meshes associated with them.

exposed_options.name: Multiple Atlas Factor
exposed_options.description: Divide each atlas into new atlases. This leads to duplicated atlas count which paired with a low texture resolution (2k) can be a good alternative to fewer atlases with higher texture resolution (4k).

exposed_options.name: Mesh and Material Merging
exposed_options.description: Merging of nodes before decimation. Full merge vs none (no merge), or byOpacity leaving alpha parts separately, byMaterial will keep parts associated with different materials separate.
